Resolves #21617

🌿 *Seeing the whole week no longer costs a planner the morning they were reading.*

Related: #21346 · #21140 · #21613 · stacked on #21696

Adds `examples/scheduler/zoom`: Harbour Hall's week of 7–13 December, twelve rooms and 122 sessions (a conference Monday to Friday, a community Saturday, a hack day on Sunday), read at the scheduler's three `zoomPresets` from one segmented control: Hours for one morning, Days for a day and a half, Week for the whole week. The control is one named group, its pressed button the active level. The plan opens at Days on Monday 08:00 through `scrollToDate`, and with #21696 every zoom keeps the date at the timeline's left edge, so Hours shows that morning and Week starts the week from it. A legend line names the four bar colours; the week level labels its days `Tue 8`; titles take two lines, and a bar too narrow for one shows its shape only; the body's gridlines follow each level's ticks. Rooms and sessions are stores of models (`RoomModel`, `SessionModel` extending `Neo.timeline.model.Event`). No shared file.

**Merge order:** this branch carries #21696's two commits (`80fb74bc3e`, `be69448eba`) until it merges; #21617 is `blocked_by` #21693, so the Fleet holds this merge until then. The example's own commits start at `52bce7dbdd`.

Evidence: L3 (Chromium at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, five themes; `Zoom.spec.mjs` in `e2e-engine`; the frames and cold read below) → L3 required (every AC is a browser observation or the look). Residual: none for #21617; publication belongs to #21613.

## Deltas from ticket

- **What stays in view:** the date at the timeline's left edge, by #21696 (step 1's drive measured the jump on `dev`: Week at 20,000 px showed 6 Apr at its left edge, Day at the same offset 2 Feb). While the timeline's start is in view nothing scrolls.
- **Seven days, not five:** the axis runs Monday to Monday, so Week scrolls 228 px at 1440 and a round trip Hours → Week → Hours keeps Monday 08:00. A week that fits the view would clamp to its start and lose the place on the way back.
- **122 sessions** (ticket: about 120): 22 on each conference day, 8 on Saturday, 4 on Sunday; every room keeps an hour between sessions, and three rooms start their talks half an hour later on Tuesday and Thursday.
- **The control's group:** a Container takes `role: 'group'` through its `role` config and its label through `changeVdomRootKey`; a `vdom` override never reached the DOM. The same fix went into #21687.
- **The cold read changed the example** (first head: desktop 6, phone 4): the legend, the `Tue 8` day labels (the engine's `08` read as hours), two-line titles, gridlines per level, and rooms that no longer read as copies.
- **Week names Monday by the week label only:** keeping 08:00 puts Monday's day tick start 72 px left of the view, and the header pins major labels, not minor ones. Out of scope, noted in defect-note "a day whose start is scrolled out loses its name at the week preset".

Frame critique:
- At Days most talks are 30 to 45 px wide and show their shape only; their titles read at Hours (accepted: Days answers "how full is the day", Hours "what is on", and the legend says what each colour is).
- At Days the night between Monday 18:00 and Tuesday 08:00 is an empty band (accepted: the venue is closed; it is the shape of the week).
- At Week a hall's three talks sit as three adjacent bars: bars keep a minimum width, so an hour's gap closes at nine pixels an hour (accepted: the week view counts sessions, Hours separates them).
- At Week Monday's day label sits just left of the view; the week label above names the range (kept: the defect-note above).
- The `Room` header keeps the grid's header colour beside the timeline header (kept: #21703, mine, fixes every scheduler and Gantt header at once).

## Cold look

One reader of this seat (Claude Sonnet, no session context) read the first head's four frames beside `scheduler/basic`'s: **desktop 6/10, phone 4/10** (`scheduler/basic`: 5 and 3); better than the sibling at both sizes. Its findings and their fate:

| Finding | Fate |
|---|---|
| The Days frame never says what is booked | legend line added; titles at Hours |
| Week's day ticks `08 09 10` read as hours | `Tue 8` labels |
| Bars collide into double borders | an hour between every room's sessions; at Week, bars keep a minimum width (critique above) |
| No legend | added |
| Hours titles truncated | two lines |
| Rooms A–D look cloned | each talk room keeps its own times |
| Body gridlines off the header ticks | `--neo-timeline-gridline-step` per level |
| Phone shows about eight hours; the room column is wide | room names shortened, the column 156 → 120 px |
| Week: Monday unlabeled | kept, defect-note |
